title: Files
help: Give students several files, such as main.c, sum.c and sum.h. Choose which files are compiled together.
to_single_confirm: Keep only the first compiled file and remove the others?
read_only_help: Students see it but cannot change it.
open_help: Opened as a tab when a student arrives.
compiled_help: Passed to the compiler. Headers are included, not compiled.
learner_sources_help: Off: only the files above are compiled, as on Elice when the script names its files.
